items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This is Ross Snyder. ... I liked him.

ctx.x: This is Ross Snyder. [Liston tries to identify a second man.] I liked him. Not then. Maybe 15 years later. I can’t remember his name.
[identifies Lorenzo.] Do you remember how he played trumpet? Because he’s a saxophone player. He’s playing trumpet.
